question: Which of the following is a book by Lewis Carroll?

options.text: The Man Who Would be King

solution:
The correct answer is __**Alice's Adventures in Wonderland.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alice's Adventure in Wonderland **is a book by **Lewis Carroll.**
 
• **Charles Lutwidge Dodgson** (27 January 1832 - 14 January 1898), better known by his pen name Lewis Carroll, was an English writer of children's fiction, notably Alice's Adventures in Wonderland and its sequel Through the Looking-Glass.
 
• He was noted for his facility with word play, logic, and fantasy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Rikki-Tikki-Tavi" **is a short story in the 1894 anthology The Jungle Book by Rudyard Kipling.
 
• **"The Man Who Would Be King" **(1888) is a story by Rudyard Kipling
 
• **The Jungle Book (1894) **is a collection of stories by the English author Rudyard Kipling.
